status: Redone in the BlinkWrite brand kit style on 2026-10-14 at Diana's request ("redo the code to figma visual using the current brand kit"). Same headline and four steps as the 2026-10-13 version. Same day: "remove the plan label, and make it a bit faster, and add some checks on each step done". Then: "make the video move faster" and "enphasize in the title 80% of Figma" (a #E0FF82 highlight behind the words, ink text, like selected text).
brand_kit: BlinkWrite brand kit 2.19, approved 2026-09-14. Light layout: #FAFAFB background, ink #1F2223, muted #596165, rules #D4D9D5, lime #90BF00 cursor, step checks and footer marker, pale lime #F3F9E0 step highlight, #526D00 active step number, 72 px margins, Onest for text, Geist Mono for labels.
launch_hold: No BlinkWrite logo, name or link: the post goes out before launch.
fonts: fonts/: Onest 400 and 500, Geist Mono 500, copied from the kit; SIL OFL 1.1, licence files included.
designer: assets/designer.png: the woman from the kit's approved human cast (characters/human-cast.png), cropped 580 x 580 at 1458,30 and scaled to 320 px. Illustrative, not a team member.
animation: 8.5 s loop at 30 fps: the full plan for 0.5 s, each step for 1.5 s with the lime cursor in it, its number turning into a check when the highlight moves on, then the full plan with all four checked for 2 s. The PNG is that final state.
build: python3 build-animation.py, then PLAYWRIGHT_PATH=<playwright> node render-animation.cjs
